title: Watches and rings
description: Connect a watch, ring or band so Today shows what it measures on its own. Nothing to type.
off: Connecting watches is not available yet. Meanwhile, see the example in Today.
demo: Demo accounts use the simulated watch and do not connect real watches.
unavailable: Watch data is not available in this environment.
nativeOnly: Requires the Ultra Hero phone app
noDataYet: No data yet: it arrives when the watch syncs with the brand's app.
revokedHint: You deauthorized Ultra Hero in the brand's app. Reconnect or delete the data; without an answer, we delete it in 30 days.

disconnect.title: Disconnect {brand}?
disconnect.body: We delete right now all data that came from {brand} and ask the brand to remove Ultra Hero's access. This cannot be undone.

consentPanel.title: Your consent
consentPanel.none: You have not authorized the use of watch data yet.
consentPanel.outdated: We updated how we handle watch data. Review and accept again to keep receiving data.
consentPanel.reduceHint: Untick to remove a category: its data is deleted right away. To add a category, connect again and accept the text.
consentPanel.revokeBody: We disconnect every watch, delete all data and ask the brands to remove access. This cannot be undone.

consent.title: Connect {brand}
consent.intro: Before connecting, choose what Ultra Hero may read from your {brand}. This is health data (sensitive data, LGPD art. 11): it only comes in with your consent, per category, and you can withdraw it whenever you want.
consent.categoriesHint: Tick at least one. Only what the device measures on its own; nothing typed in.
consent.textVersion: Version {version} · we keep this version and your choice as proof of consent.
consent.notDo: We do not use this data for ads, selling or recommending products, statistics, external AI, heroes or suppliers.
consent.age: I declare that I am {age} or older.
consent.agePending: The age rule is being defined by the legal team.
consent.submit: I agree and want to connect
consent.reauthBody: To authorize health data, sign in to your account again. You come back to this screen right after.
consent.wellness: Watch data, for wellness. Not a diagnosis and no substitute for medical advice.

readiness.name: Daily index
readiness.desc: Body Battery, Readiness, Recovery, Nightly Recharge and the day's strain.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.desc: Duration, stages, times and the brand's sleep score.

heart.name: Heart
heart.desc: Resting HR, HRV, VO₂ max and the day's heart rate.

activity.name: Activity
activity.desc: Steps, distance, active calories, floors and intensity minutes.

workout.name: Workouts
workout.desc: Workouts started or detected by the device, of every type, without GPS routes.

breathing.name: Breathing and oxygen
breathing.desc: Breathing and SpO₂ measured during sleep.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.desc: Skin temperature during sleep, compared with your usual.

stress.name: Stress
stress.desc: Stress level and time measured by the device.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.demo: Demo accounts do not connect real watches.
errors.age: Confirm the age statement to continue.
errors.version: The consent text changed. Read the new version and confirm.
errors.unavailable: Connecting watches is not available right now.
errors.denied: The connection was cancelled on the brand's screen. Nothing was stored.
errors.state: The connection expired or came from another session. Start again.
errors.provider: The brand did not answer as expected. Try again later.
errors.inUse: This brand account is already connected to another Ultra Hero profile.

historyNote: History starts on the day you connect: earlier data is not fetched in this version.
